notes: 0.4: allow-list. Only the game files named in include are copied (by name, from any store; a mod's .disabled copy counts), so mods and maps in the player's install never reach the Edition. ?path = optional, * and ? = whatever is there. exclude/keep stay for launchers older than alpha.5. 0.5: ownUserFolder - the Edition's exe reads its own HKCU key, so profiles, saves and settings live in Documents\IranCoJ Edition (launcher alpha.8+). 0.5.1: menuNavigation (Play -> Join/Host, Back -> main menu, patched in the Edition's CoJ2_x86.dll by pattern; launcher alpha.10+), compiled menu packs in edition/files, the multiplayer maps' loading screens (*_loading.rpack). Loading music is copied by the launcher from the tracks the maps' .trk files name. 0.6: the multiplayer maps' own rpacks too (compiled map data such as rivers and lightmaps is only there - without them Tombstone had no water), engine.rpack (the engine's compiled shader sets, hit splatters, lighting) and textures1.rpack (shared textures, e.g. the rivers' reflections); Persepolis Dust menus, in-game screens, Oswald font, own menu music and credits.
